{{Top|leg}}
'''Life-crystal trees''', from which [[life-crystal]]s were harvested, grew on the planet [[Rafa V]]. Life-crystals were believed to extend life and provide good health. In actuality, a high concentration of life-crystals served only to sap intelligence. In [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] was tied to a life-crystal tree and left to [[Death/Legends|die]] by the Rafan natives, known as the [[Sharu/Legends|Toka]] people.

== Description ==
Life-crystal tree trunks appeared to be made from ordinary wooden bark at first glance, but upon further inspection, the trunk of the tree was made from a fibrous glassy pigmented stem which measured to about a half meter through, and a couple of meters tall. The Life-crystal tree [[root]] system was note worthy as being odd. Life-crystal trees rested on bases that were shaped like irregular disks with a circumference of 2 meters, composed of the same glassy substance as the trunk, giving it a [[toy]] appearance. The disk bases curved downward into the ground at the edges. The undersurface of the tree was composed of hair-fine glassy roots that went as deep as about 1 kilometer, and spread out as far as the longest of the tree branches. The branches resembled [[cactus]] branches. The branches shot out from the trunk and then upward at a right angle. The lower the branches on the trunk, the larger the distance the branches extended before they pointed upward. The entire tree looked conical.st the tip of each branch, a life crystal would grow. On the outermost branches, the crystal would be about fist sized, while the crystals on the inner branches would be about the size of a pinhead. Each tree was believed to be able to grow about one thousand crystals. 

The life-crystals had to be removed by a [[laser]] and he tree would regrow the crystal within the span of a year.{{Flora-stub}}
